example_sentences.de: Ich brauche warme Kleidung für den Winter.
example_sentences.en: I need warm clothing for the winter.
The clothes are in the wardrobe.

cloze.en: Please bring warm clothing.

words.notes: Uncountable — there is no plural. For individual items say 'die Kleidungsstücke'.

cloze.de: Zum Anzug trage ich ein blaues ___.
cloze.en: With the suit I wear a blue shirt.

words.notes: A formal button-up shirt. A T-shirt is 'das T-Shirt'.

example_sentences.de: Im Sommer trage ich meistens T-Shirts.
example_sentences.en: In summer I mostly wear T-shirts.

cloze.en: He's wearing a black T-shirt.

example_sentences.de: Zieh einen Pullover an, es ist kalt.
example_sentences.en: Put on a jumper, it's cold.
The jumper is made of wool.

cloze.de: Es ist kalt, nimm einen ___ mit.
cloze.en: It's cold, take a jumper.

words.notes: Everyone says 'Pulli' in everyday speech. -er ending, masculine.

example_sentences.de: Hängen Sie Ihre Jacke bitte dorthin.
example_sentences.en: Please hang your jacket over there.

cloze.en: It's raining — don't forget your jacket!

words.notes: -e ending, feminine.

example_sentences.de: Im Winter brauche ich einen dicken Mantel.
example_sentences.en: In winter I need a thick coat.

example_sentences.de: Der Mantel hängt an der Garderobe.
example_sentences.en: The coat is hanging in the cloakroom.

cloze.en: Put your coat on, it's snowing.

words.notes: Umlaut in the plural: der Mantel → die Mäntel.

example_sentences.de: Ich kaufe mir eine neue Hose.

cloze.en: These trousers don't fit me any more.

words.notes: Careful: singular in German ('eine Hose'), plural in English ('trousers').

example_sentences.en: I wear jeans almost all the time.

example_sentences.de: Die Jeans ist mir zu eng.
example_sentences.en: The jeans are too tight for me.

cloze.en: My new jeans were quite expensive.

cloze.de: Der ___ passt gut zu der Bluse.
cloze.en: The skirt goes well with the blouse.

words.notes: Also means rock music — 'die Rockmusik'.

example_sentences.de: Sie kauft ein Kleid für die Hochzeit.
example_sentences.en: She's buying a dress for the wedding.

cloze.en: She's wearing a beautiful blue dress.

words.notes: The plural 'die Kleider' can also mean clothes in general.

example_sentences.de: Ich bügle noch schnell die Bluse.

cloze.de: Zu dem Rock passt die weiße ___.
cloze.en: The white blouse goes with the skirt.

example_sentences.de: Zum Vorstellungsgespräch trage ich einen Anzug.
example_sentences.en: I'll wear a suit to the job interview.

cloze.de: Für die Hochzeit brauche ich einen ___.
cloze.en: I need a suit for the wedding.

words.germany_context: German offices are less formal than you might expect — outside banking and law, a suit is unusual even for interviews at tech companies.

cloze.en: A tie goes with the suit.

cloze.de: Ich brauche neue ___ für den Winter.
cloze.en: I need new socks for the winter.

words.notes: Almost always used in the plural: die Socken.

cloze.en: What size are these shoes?

words.germany_context: Taking your shoes off when entering someone's home is normal and expected in Germany. Wait to be told otherwise.

example_sentences.de: Im Winter trage ich warme Stiefel.
example_sentences.en: In winter I wear warm boots.

cloze.en: You need boots when it snows.

words.notes: -el ending, masculine. Same form in the plural.

example_sentences.de: Setz eine Mütze auf, es ist kalt!
example_sentences.en: Put a hat on, it's cold!

cloze.de: Bei minus fünf Grad brauchst du eine ___.
cloze.en: At minus five degrees you need a hat.

words.notes: A soft warm hat. A formal hat with a brim is 'der Hut'.

example_sentences.de: Sie hat mir einen Schal gestrickt.

cloze.de: Vergiss deinen ___ nicht, es ist eisig.
cloze.en: Don't forget your scarf, it's freezing.

cloze.de: Meine Hände frieren — wo sind die ___?
cloze.en: My hands are freezing — where are the gloves?

words.notes: Literally 'hand shoe' — a nicely logical compound.
words.mnemonic: Hand + Schuh = a shoe for your hand.

example_sentences.de: Der Schlüssel ist in der Tasche.
example_sentences.en: The key is in the bag.

cloze.de: Ich habe mein Handy in der ___.
cloze.en: I have my phone in my bag.

words.notes: Means both a bag and a pocket in clothing.

example_sentences.en: I can't see anything without my glasses.

cloze.de: Ich brauche eine neue ___ zum Lesen.
cloze.en: I need new glasses for reading.

words.notes: Singular in German ('eine Brille'), plural in English ('glasses').

example_sentences.de: Nimm deine Sonnenbrille mit an den Strand.
example_sentences.en: Take your sunglasses to the beach.

cloze.de: Die Sonne blendet — wo ist meine ___?
cloze.en: The sun is blinding — where are my sunglasses?
It's raining — do you have an umbrella?

words.notes: Usually shortened to 'der Schirm'.
words.germany_context: German weather changes fast. A folding umbrella in your bag from October to April is standard practice.

example_sentences.de: Das Kleid steht dir sehr gut.

cloze.en: The new coat suits you!

words.notes: With the dative it means 'to suit'. 'Das steht dir gut' is the standard compliment about clothes.

example_sentences.en: The T-shirt is made of cotton.

example_sentences.de: Baumwolle ist angenehm auf der Haut.
example_sentences.en: Cotton is pleasant on the skin.

cloze.en: This shirt is made of pure cotton.

words.notes: Literally 'tree wool'.
words.mnemonic: Baum (tree) + Wolle (wool) → cotton grows on a plant.

example_sentences.en: The jumper is made of wool.

cloze.en: This scarf is made of soft wool.

example_sentences.de: Die Jacke ist aus echtem Leder.
example_sentences.en: The jacket is made of real leather.

cloze.en: These shoes are made of leather.
She's wearing a light green dress.

words.notes: Attaches directly to a colour with no space: hellblau, hellgrün, hellgrau.

example_sentences.en: He's wearing a dark blue suit.

cloze.en: I'd like the dark grey jacket.

words.notes: Also joins directly: dunkelblau, dunkelrot. Note the comparative drops the e: dunkel → dunkler.

example_sentences.en: The market is nice and colourful.

cloze.de: Im Herbst sind die Blätter sehr ___.
cloze.en: In autumn the leaves are very colourful.

example_sentences.de: Welche Farbe magst du am liebsten?
example_sentences.en: Which colour do you like best?

cloze.de: Haben Sie das auch in einer anderen ___?
cloze.en: Do you have this in another colour too?

words.notes: Also means paint.

cloze.en: The water here is almost turquoise.
I'm looking for a beige coat.

words.notes: Pronounced the French way, roughly 'besch'.

cloze.en: The flowers in the garden are purple.

words.notes: Never takes an adjective ending — 'ein lila Kleid', not 'ein lilanes Kleid'. Same for rosa and orange.

example_sentences.de: Das Baby hat eine rosa Mütze.
example_sentences.en: The baby has a pink hat.

cloze.en: She bought a pink dress.

words.notes: Like lila, it never takes an ending.

example_sentences.de: Ich muss noch die Wäsche waschen.
example_sentences.en: I still have to do the laundry.

example_sentences.de: Die Wäsche hängt auf dem Balkon.
example_sentences.en: The washing is hanging on the balcony.

cloze.en: On Saturday I do the laundry.

words.germany_context: Many German flats have no dryer — clothes are hung on a Wäscheständer. Note also the Ruhezeiten: running a washing machine after 22:00 or on a Sunday will annoy your neighbours.

example_sentences.en: The underwear is in the wardrobe.

cloze.de: Pack genug ___ für die Reise ein.
cloze.en: Pack enough underwear for the trip.

words.notes: Uncountable, no plural.

cloze.en: She almost never wears jewellery.

words.notes: Uncountable — no plural.

cloze.en: He gave her a ring.

words.germany_context: Germans wear the wedding ring on the RIGHT hand, not the left.

example_sentences.en: The belt is made of leather.

cloze.de: Die Hose rutscht — ich brauche einen ___.
cloze.en: The trousers are slipping — I need a belt.

words.notes: -el ending, masculine, same in the plural.
